# Robert Half

> > Robert Half is a global staffing and consulting firm specializing in talent acquisition, permanent placement, and professional services across finance, technology, legal, and creative industries.

Robert Half operates through multiple service lines including direct staffing (Robert Half brand), creative staffing (The Creative Group), and consulting services (Protiviti). The platform serves both job seekers and employers with specialized recruiting, contract staffing, permanent placement, and management consulting across multiple industries.

## Key Topics

- Staffing Solutions
- Job Search & Placement
- Finance & Accounting
- Technology & IT
- Contract & Temporary Staffing
- Permanent Placement
- Executive Search
- Protiviti Consulting
- Digital Transformation
- Risk & Compliance
- Talent Acquisition
- Remote Work
- Salary & Compensation Data
- AI & Skills Development
- Recruitment Services

## Job Search & Placement

- [Search Jobs](https://www.roberthalf.com/us/en/jobs): Job search portal with daily updated roles across finance, tech, and marketing.
- [How to Find a Job Using Recruiters & Staffing Agencies](https://www.roberthalf.com/us/en/find-jobs/partner): Guide to job search using Robert Half recruiters and staffing services.

## Staffing Solutions for Employers

- [Contract, Temp, Flexible Staffing & Hiring](https://www.roberthalf.com/us/en/hire-talent/flexible-staffing): Flexible staffing solutions for temporary and contract talent needs.
- [Full-Time Staffing, Hiring & Permanent Placement](https://www.roberthalf.com/us/en/hire-talent/full-time-staffing): Full-time staffing and permanent hiring solutions for businesses.
- [Executive Search Recruiting & Placement Services](https://www.roberthalf.com/us/en/hire-talent/executive-search): Executive search and C-suite placement services for growth companies.
- [Hiring & Staffing Help: How to Work with Recruiters](https://www.roberthalf.com/us/en/hire-talent/partner): Guide for companies on working with Robert Half recruiters and Protiviti.

## Industry-Specific Staffing

- [Finance & Accounting Staffing and Recruiting](https://www.roberthalf.com/us/en/accounting-finance): Finance and accounting staffing for temporary contracts or permanent roles.
- [IT Recruiters & Tech Staffing](https://www.roberthalf.com/us/en/tech-it): Tech and IT staffing for temporary contracts or permanent placements.
- [Creative & Marketing Staffing and Recruiting](https://www.roberthalf.com/us/en/marketing-creative): Creative and marketing staffing through Robert Half and The Creative Group.
- [Legal, Attorney & Paralegal Staffing and Recruiting](https://www.roberthalf.com/us/en/legal): Legal staffing for paralegals, attorneys, and legal professionals.

## Protiviti Consulting Services

- [Consulting & Staffing for Technology Projects](https://www.roberthalf.com/us/en/consulting/tech): Tech consulting and staffing for cloud, cybersecurity, and quantum projects.
- [Consulting for Risk, Audit & Compliance Projects](https://www.roberthalf.com/us/en/consulting/risk-compliance-audit): Risk, compliance, and audit consulting through Protiviti and Robert Half.
- [Consulting for Finance & Accounting Projects](https://www.roberthalf.com/us/en/consulting/finance): Finance and accounting consulting including IPO and process automation.
- [Consulting & Staffing for Legal Projects](https://www.roberthalf.com/us/en/consulting/legal): Legal consulting including ESG, compliance, and data privacy services.
- [HR Consulting Solutions and Staffing](https://www.roberthalf.com/us/en/consulting/human-resources): HR consulting with Workday, SAP, Oracle implementation and talent management.

## Digital & Marketing Consulting

- [Consulting & Staffing for Digital & Marketing Projects](https://www.roberthalf.com/us/en/consulting/digital): Digital transformation and marketing consulting with staffing services.

## Market Insights & Salary Data

- [2026 Salary Guide](https://www.roberthalf.com/us/en/insights/salary-guide): 2026 salary benchmarks and compensation data across finance, tech, legal.
- [2025 Tech & IT Priorities and Hiring Challenges](https://www.roberthalf.com/us/en/insights/building-tech-teams): Report on 2025 tech priorities, AI, ML, and IT security hiring challenges.
- [Job Search Strategies Guide: Navigating the 2026 Job Market](https://www.roberthalf.com/us/en/insights/job-market-outlook): 2026 job market strategies guide covering resume, skills, and AI tools.
